title: EVPN IGMP Proxy - CLI syntax divergence (snoop-DB show)
description: System-architect CLI story SW-251450 (owner Menachem Dodge, To Do) specifies 'show evpn igmp-snooping multicast-db' as the snoop-DB show; code on feature/evpn_igmp_proxy_integration_v1 registers 'show evpn igmp-snooping groups'/'interfaces'. SA story is the syntax source of truth pre-live; keep 'multicast-db' as spec (EXPECTED_LIVE_VALIDATE) until the first lab build resolves it. Do NOT rewrite the TP to match code.
